test_stereo_model: test a CroCo model on stereo datasets using tiled prediction and save metrics
test_flow_model: test a CroCo model on optical flow datasets with configurable tile overlap and confidence mode
run_tiled_prediction: run tiled prediction on image pairs using the model with specified crop size and overlap
save_predictions: save model predictions as raw tensors, visualizations, or error maps to disk
evaluate_metrics: evaluate stereo or flow model metrics and save results as a pickle file
